WITH cur AS (SELECT * FROM dim_member WHERE is_current)
SELECT m.home_store_id, count(*) AS rows_cur, count(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS members,
  (SELECT count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM dim_member) AS all_members,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member) AS all_rows,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member WHERE is_current GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)) AS dup_current,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member GROUP BY 1 HAVING sum(CASE WHEN is_current THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)<>1)) AS no_one_current
FROM cur m WHERE m.home_store_id IN (115,116,117,136,900,999) GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1

WITH asof AS (SELECT DATE '2026-10-04' AS d),
ver AS (  -- member version valid on as-of Sunday
  SELECT m.* FROM dim_member m, asof WHERE m.valid_from <= asof.d AND m.valid_to >= asof.d),
act AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key, asof
  WHERE f.sale_date > asof.d - 364 AND f.sale_date <= asof.d
    AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test')
SELECT v.home_store_id,
  count(DISTINCT v.member_id) AS members_asof_ver,
  count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.member_id IS NOT NULL THEN v.member_id END) AS active_members,
  count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN v.marketing_consent THEN v.member_id END) AS consent
FROM ver v LEFT JOIN act a ON a.member_id = v.member_id
WHERE v.home_store_id IN (115,116,117,136,900,999) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH ao AS (SELECT DATE '2026-10-04' AS d),
ver AS (
  SELECT m.* FROM dim_member m, ao WHERE m.valid_from <= ao.d AND m.valid_to >= ao.d),
act AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key, ao
  WHERE f.sale_date > ao.d - 364 AND f.sale_date <= ao.d
    AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test')
SELECT v.home_store_id,
  count(DISTINCT v.member_id) AS members_asof_ver,
  count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.member_id IS NOT NULL THEN v.member_id END) AS active_members,
  count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN v.marketing_consent THEN v.member_id END) AS consent
FROM ver v LEFT JOIN act a ON a.member_id = v.member_id
WHERE v.home_store_id IN (115,116,117,136,900,999) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH tampere_stores AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT store_id FROM dim_store
  WHERE city = 'Tampere' AND store_id < 900),
member_asof AS (
  SELECT m.member_id, m.home_store_id FROM dim_member m
  WHERE m.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-04' AND m.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-04'),
active_members AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE f.sale_date > DATE '2026-10-04' - 364 AND f.sale_date <= DATE '2026-10-04'
    AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test')
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.member_id) AS active_members_tampere
FROM member_asof a
JOIN tampere_stores t ON t.store_id = a.home_store_id
JOIN active_members am ON am.member_id = a.member_id
